name: Three Turtle Doves
source:
Zack and his husband, Diego, travel to a cabin in a small town for Christmas. With the magic of the holidays, Zack finds himself swept off the dance floor and into the arms of another. How will he navigate this love triangle situation?

[From [url=https://alicedgames.itch.io/three-turtle-doves]itch.io[/url]]
